handoff.salientSummary: Report builder now lists Bookings and Waitlist entries for report readers (staff and reservation grants are combined in all three report routes). The booking sheet shows closed-day, online_closed, pacing and held states with EN/AR strings. Checked live on acme in agent-browser, and the unit, typecheck, lint, Lingui and Playwright checks pass.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Added resolveReportGrantsForRequest (reservations/report-access.server.ts), which unions staff and reservation report subjects. The reports _index, new and $reportId loaders and actions now use it, so catalogs, templates, saved reports and the save actions all see Bookings and Waitlist entries. book-api.ts: searchBookAvailability returns dayState (closed, online_closed, open) and per-slot held/heldTableIds; createPhoneReservation takes overrideClosedDay (sends overbook with a closed-day reason) and returns warnings. booking-sheet.tsx: closed day shows a warning and no slots, disables Create until the 'Override closed day' box is checked; online_closed shows an info flag with slots still bookable; over-paced slots show a pacing warning and send the overbook flag; held slots get a lock/Held chip and an alert naming the held table(s), with the override sent only when the hold blocks the slot (no other table free); 409 closed_day/pacing errors map to translated text and response warnings show a translated toast. Lingui EN/AR filled.

A test reservation 'UI Closed Tester' (+15555559701) was booked on 2026-10-20 in acme during live verification. The two test special days were deleted, but this booking remains in the local tenant DB.
